A first restaurant, with her own name over the door.

PAM stands for People Around Me. It is chef Karla Knowles' first restaurant with her own name over the door.

She comes to Charterhouse Street after almost eight years as head chef at Kiln, bringing that live fire discipline with her.

The cooking is Northern Thai, cooked over live fire, built on British seasonal produce and European technique.

Plates are made for sharing, so the table eats together, the way the name suggests.

From teaser to full table PAM soft launched from 22 to 31 October 2026 and opened fully on Tuesday 3 November 2026.
